tabs.label: Plan views
title: Workout templates
lead: Your templates show up in the workout editor's Insert template menu (by category); the built-in ones cite their source and are read-only: copy one to change it.
empty: Pick a template on the left, or press New template.
name: Template name
basis_hint: When applied, the session's Targets by follows the template; Auto steps follow the session type
none: No templates in this category yet
none_mine: No templates of your own yet: press New template, or Save as template in a workout's structure
copied: Copied to your templates: you can change it now
gpx_none: No GPX: once uploaded, its elevation is drawn lightly behind the workout chart
gpx_save_first: Save the template first, then upload a training-route GPX
